verdict.rationale: Cloudflare MoQ Relay is a managed media-relay service, so an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence shows only dashboard and REST API management, plus a platform-wide llms.txt and OpenAPI spec. These are adjacent building blocks, not an MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
